comment.narrative: The baseline needs analysis conducted at the beginning of the intervention showed that the majority of the media practitioners working with the selected community radio stations do not have a background in journalism and require training on basics of journalism in addition to the trainings outlined for the programs needs. The journalism mentors have started delivering the trainings as per the needs analysis. In order for this indicator to be fully met more trainings will need to be delivered on conflict sensitive journalism and inclusion of marginalized communities to meet the expected outcome. The trainings are planned to be delivered in the coming months.
